Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: Lithospheric plates have moved to form land formations on the Earth's surface. Which land formation occurs as a result of the plates folding upon one another?
A. an earthquake
B. a mountain range
C. a river
D. a volcano
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
